## Outcome

Describe the problem and the resulting behavior. For refactors, describe the
responsibility moved and the contracts preserved.

## Review scope

Explain why these changes belong together. Identify mechanical moves separately
from behavior changes, and explain unusually large diffs. Link independent
follow-ups instead of adding unrelated work to this PR.

## Validation

List the checks run and their results, plus any integration checks still needed.
See [the maintenance guide](../Docs/codebase-maintenance.md) for relevant checks.
